name: PyInstaller macOS Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-macos:
    runs-on: macos-14
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.11'
        
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install pyinstaller
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        
    - name: Convert icon to ICNS
      run: |
        # Create temporary directory for icon conversion
        mkdir -p temp_icons
        # Use ImageMagick to convert PNG to ICNS (if available)
        if command -v magick &> /dev/null; then
          magick icon.png temp_icons/icon.icns
        elif command -v convert &> /dev/null; then
          convert icon.png temp_icons/icon.icns
        else
          # Fallback: create minimal ICNS structure
          echo "Warning: ImageMagick not found, skipping icon conversion"
        fi
        
    - name: Build with PyInstaller
      run: |
        # Check if spec file exists
        if [ -f "obi-macos.spec" ]; then
          pyinstaller obi-macos.spec
        else
          echo "Error: obi-macos.spec file not found"
          exit 1
        fi
        
    - name: Create DMG package
      run: |
        # Create DMG using create-dmg if available
        if command -v create-dmg &> /dev/null; then
          create-dmg \
            --volname "Open Battery Information" \
            --background "./assets/dmg-background.png" \
            --window-pos 200 120 \
            --window-size 800 400 \
            --icon-size 100 \
            --icon "Open Battery Information.app" 200 190 \
            --hide-extension "Open Battery Information.app" \
            --app-drop-link 600 185 \
            "open-battery-information.dmg" \
            "dist/Open Battery Information.app"
        else
          echo "Warning: create-dmg not found, creating basic archive"
          cd dist
          zip -r "../open-battery-information-macos.zip" "Open Battery Information.app"
        fi
        
    - name: Upload artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: macos-app
        path: |
          dist/*.app
          *.dmg
          *.zip
          
    - name: Test build
      run: |
        # Verify the app can be launched (basic check)
        if [ -d "dist/Open Battery Information.app" ]; then
          echo "Application built successfully"
        else
          echo "Error: Application build failed"
          exit 1
        fi
